items.name: notify
items.title: defineNotify (in-app + email)
items.description: Build a typed `notify(userId, type, data)` helper that writes an in-app notification row AND sends a transactional email in one call, respecting per-user / per-type preferences. Pair with `send-email` + your Notification Prisma table.

items.name: notification-preferences
items.title: NotificationPreferences (channel × type matrix)
items.description: Per-channel × per-type Switch matrix (in-app / email / push × comments / mentions / billing / digest …) with debounced autosave and an inline saved/saving status. Pair with a `prefs` Prisma table keyed by (userId, type, channel).

items.name: email-verification
items.title: sendEmailVerification + verifyEmailToken
items.description: Email verification flow with single-use, SHA-256-hashed, TTL'd tokens. `sendEmailVerification(userId)` issues a 24h link and emails it via `send-email`. `verifyEmailToken(rawToken)` checks expiry, marks the user verified in a transaction, and deletes the token. Optional `pruneExpiredEmailTokens()` for a daily QStash cron.

items.name: digest-scheduler
items.title: sendUserDigest + runDigestBatch
items.description: Notification digest scheduler. Batches in-app notifications into a daily / weekly email so high-volume users aren't drowned. `runDigestBatch(cadence)` is the QStash cron entrypoint; `sendUserDigest(userId, cadence)` handles one user. Marks each included notification with `digestSentAt` so it's never re-emailed.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: NotificationBell (topbar popover)
items.description: Topbar bell + popover for in-app notifications. Unread count badge (9+ cap), per-item mark-as-read on click, 'mark all read' bulk action, configurable polling interval (or 0 to use realtime push). Bring your own `loadNotifications`, `markRead`, `markAllRead`.
